setup: CREATE TABLE contract_facts (id INT PRIMARY KEY, grp TEXT, k INT, v INT, enabled BOOL)

cases.name: weekday_uses_explicit_input_offset
cases.sql: SELECT ISODOW('2024-03-01T00:30:00+14:00') AS friday, DATEPART(ISO_WEEKDAY,'2024-03-03T23:30:00-12:00') AS sunday

cases.name: boundaries_are_not_complete_months
cases.sql: SELECT DATEDIFF(MONTH,'2024-01-31','2024-02-29') AS boundaries, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH,'2024-01-31','2024-02-29') AS complete

cases.name: wide_integer_date_result
cases.sql: SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1000-01-01','2000-01-01') AS elapsed_seconds

cases.name: exact_subseconds_survive_text_transport
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(DATEDIFF(NANOSECOND,'1970-01-01T00:00:00Z','2262-04-11T23:47:16.854775807Z') AS TEXT) AS positive, CAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(NANOSECOND,'1970-01-01T00:00:00Z','1677-09-21T00:12:43.145224192Z') AS TEXT) AS negative

cases.name: statement_clock_is_shared
cases.sql: SELECT NOW() = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS same

cases.name: null_is_distinct_from_empty_and_false
cases.sql: SELECT ISNULL(NULL) AS absent, ISNULL('') AS empty, ISNULL(FALSE) AS is_false, COALESCE('ok',1/0) AS lazy

cases.name: unicode_and_explicit_trim_sets
cases.sql: SELECT TRIM(' text ') AS whitespace, LTRIM('🙂xxtext','🙂x') AS characters, TRIM(' text ','') AS empty_set, TRIM(NULL,1/0) AS lazy_null

cases.name: filtered_aggregates_keep_empty_groups
cases.sql: SELECT grp, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE enabled) AS n, SUM(v) FILTER (WHERE enabled) AS total FROM contract_facts GROUP BY grp ORDER BY grp

cases.name: discarded_arguments_are_not_evaluated
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NULL) AS n, SUM(1/0) FILTER (WHERE FALSE) AS total FROM contract_facts

cases.name: aggregate_predicate_uses_whole_group
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(v) BETWEEN 40 AND 50 AS between_result, SUM(v) IN (47,99) AS in_result, CAST(SUM(v) AS TEXT) LIKE '4%' AS like_result FROM contract_facts

cases.name: explicit_null_placement_and_stable_page
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM contract_facts ORDER BY k ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1

cases.name: descending_values_do_not_reverse_null_placement
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM contract_facts ORDER BY k DESC NULLS LAST

cases.name: distinct_window_and_value_range
cases.sql: SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT grp) OVER () AS categories, SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY k RANGE 1 PRECEDING) AS total FROM contract_facts WHERE k IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id

cases.name: window_inside_predicate
cases.sql: SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) IN (1,2) AS first_two FROM contract_facts WHERE id<=3 ORDER BY id

cases.name: literal_split_preserves_empty_fields
cases.sql: SELECT value,ordinal FROM STRING_SPLIT('ä::🙂::::','::',1) ORDER BY ordinal

cases.name: empty_table_function_keeps_schema
cases.sql: SELECT value,ordinal FROM STRING_SPLIT(NULL,'::',1)

cases.name: reject_nested_aggregate_in_filter
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE SUM(v) IN (47)) FROM contract_facts

cases.name: reject_nested_window_in_filter
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ROW_NUMBER() OVER () BETWEEN 1 AND 2) FROM contract_facts

cases.name: reject_unknown_window_sort_key
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(v) OVER (ORDER BY missing RANGE 1 PRECEDING) FROM contract_facts

cases.name: reject_unsupported_grouped_window
cases.sql: SELECT grp,COUNT(*),ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY grp) FROM contract_facts GROUP BY grp

cases.name: reject_nested_window_argument
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(ROW_NUMBER() OVER ()) OVER () FROM contract_facts

cases.name: reject_nested_ordinary_aggregate
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(SUM(v)) FROM contract_facts

cases.name: reject_having_that_would_be_ignored
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM contract_facts HAVING FALSE

cases.name: reject_unsupported_date_modifiers
cases.sql: SELECT DATE('2024-01-01','+1 day')
